title: City paid a youth housing provider $7.2 million in fiscal 2025; State upheld 9 allegations

beats.text: This is Unity Care Group.
The City pays it to house young adults leaving homelessness or foster care.
In fiscal 2025, the City paid it 7,205,100 dollars.

visual.label: paid by the City, fiscal 2025
visual.sub: all departments; $3,525,000 of it one Mayor’s Office housing agreement

beats.text: This is a lead, not a finding.

visual.line: This is a lead, not a finding: a pattern in public records. This film says what the records show, what they do not show, and what would settle it.

beats.text: The first lead. Unity Care also holds a State licence.
It houses 43 young people in or leaving foster care.
A 2021 City memo says its grantee serves young people leaving foster care, the licence’s population.

visual.text: new $1,065,421 grant to Unity Care Group, serving young people leaving foster care
